title: Y Combinator turned a sports arena into AI's biggest pep rally
excerpt: Y Combinator filled the Chase Center with aspiring founders for its annual Startup School. Some compared it to a megachurch.
content_html:
By Henry Chandonnet

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

The CEOs walked out of the light-up tunnel like they were preparing to wrestle. A cameraman walked ahead of them, broadcasting their entrances to a San Francisco arena.

Rather than trading jabs, executives like Sam Altman, Jensen Huang, and others traded advice. They were at the Chase Center this weekend for Y Combinator's Startup School, a two-day conference for "technical builders" looking to make it big in entrepreneurship.

Startup School had everything: light-up headphones, AI versions of the YC partners, and freebies upon freebies. Here's a quick look at the spectacle.

Back to (startup) school

The Chase Center is usually decked out in the Golden State Warriors' blue and gold. For one July weekend, it was all Y Combinator orange.

A large orange Y was propped up outside the arena, inviting in the wannabe-founders from far and wide. The event was 3x larger than last year, with over 6,000 attendees, YC leaders said. The accelerator also helped people outside the Bay Area with travel support.

Inside the arena, speakers Altman and Huang received rapturous applause. Other speakers included Meta's Alexandr Wang, Anthropic's Boris Cherny, and Google's Jeff Dean. The "ClawFather" himself, OpenClaw founder Peter Steinberger, was in the room. The only major AI lab not formally represented was SpaceXAI.

Some of these speakers offered product freebies. Cherny told the crowd they'd all get six months of Anthropic's $200 Claude Max plan. Wang offered $1,000 in free Meta credits. Altman had his own deal for YC founders two months ago: tokens for equity.

Attendees described breakout sessions in the stadium, where they wore headphones to separate the noise. They also attended one of about 100 parallel small group sessions, according to general partner Ankit Gupta, including an ML research symposium.

And then there was the "Office Hours Simulator." One attendee spoke to an artificial Brad Flora — only for the real one to shake his hand.

Memes about the 'megachurch'

Y Combinator also gifted attendees a portable battery. The only potential concern flagged by one attendee: it might look a bit too much like an explosive device to fly home with.

Young tech bros post anything and everything on X. Thus, Startup School had its fair share of memes — the battery being one of them.

Other memes included the line for the men's room which, in true "Man Francisco" fashion, was longer than the line for the women's room.

The event's biggest meme, though, was religious. "YC Startup school giving megachurch vibes these days," OpenAI's Bill Chen wrote.

While some joked about the Startup School's so-called holiness, others fashioned it into a criticism. Jay Kapoor, a general partner at VSC Ventures, wrote that Startup School looked like "a megachurch for people who only worship money."

YC Partner Tyler Bosmeny clapped back: "New York City finance bro says what?"

all men do is lie, cheat, and go to yc startup school

— michelle (@michellewang857) July 25, 2026

For others, the grandness of Startup School was an abandonment of YC's principles.

"The YC brand felt like it was designed to filter out status chasers," Spellbook cofounder Scott Stevenson wrote. "You can feel the herd rushing into an overflowing barn. A stadium sized barn."

YC has always been hyper-selective, with its 1% acceptance rate. Still, YC general partner Christopher Golda defended the event's scale, writing that the accelerator's goal was never "scarcity."

"There are far more people who can, should, and will be in the arena," Golda wrote. "So yeah, we rented out an arena."

作者：Henry Chandonnet 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

首席执行官们走出灯光隧道，就像准备摔跤一样。 一名摄影师走在他们前面，直播他们进入旧金山竞技场的情况。

萨姆·奥尔特曼（Sam Altman）、黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）等高管并没有相互攻击，而是交换了建议。 这个周末，他们在大通中心参加 Y Combinator 的创业学校，这是一个为期两天的会议，专为希望在创业领域取得巨大成就的“技术建设者”而举办。

创业学校什么都有：发光耳机、YC 合作伙伴的 AI 版本以及免费赠品。 让我们快速浏览一下这一奇观。

回到（创业）学校

大通中心通常以金州勇士队的蓝色和金色装饰。 七月的一个周末，Y Combinator 的一切都是橙色的。

竞技场外竖起一个巨大的橙色 Y 字形，邀请来自四面八方的想成为创始人的人进来。 YC 领导人表示，此次活动规模比去年扩大了 3 倍，参加人数超过 6,000 人。 该加速器还为湾区以外的人们提供旅行支持。

场内，演讲者奥特曼和黄获得了热烈的掌声。 其他演讲者包括 Meta 的 Alexandr Wang、Anthropic 的 Boris Cherny 和 Google 的 Jeff Dean。 “ClawFather”本人，OpenClaw 创始人 Peter Steinberger，就在房间里。 唯一没有正式代表的主要人工智能实验室是 SpaceXAI。

其中一些演讲者提供了产品免费赠品。 Cherny 告诉观众，他们都将获得 Anthropic 的 200 美元 Claude Max 计划的六个月服务。 Wang 提供了 1,000 美元的免费 Meta 积分。 两个月前，Altman 与 YC 创始人达成了自己的协议：代币换股权。

与会者描述了在体育场举行的分组会议，他们戴着耳机来隔离噪音。 据普通合伙人 Ankit Gupta 称，他们还参加了大约 100 个平行小组会议之一，其中包括一场机器学习研究研讨会。

然后是“办公时间模拟器”。 一名与会者与人造布拉德·弗洛拉交谈——结果真人却与他握手。

关于“巨型教堂”的模因

Y Combinator 还向与会者赠送了一块便携式电池。 一位与会者提出的唯一潜在担忧是：它可能看起来有点像爆炸装置，不适合带回家。

年轻的科技兄弟在 X 上发布任何内容。 因此，创业学校有其相当多的模因——电池就是其中之一。

其他模因包括男厕所的队伍，以真正的“旧金山”时尚，比女厕所的队伍还要长。

不过，该活动最大的模因是宗教。 “如今，YC 创业学校给人一种大型教堂的感觉，”OpenAI 的 Bill Chen 写道。

一些人拿创业学校所谓的神圣性开玩笑，另一些人则将其变成了批评。 VSC Ventures 的普通合伙人杰伊·卡普尔 (Jay Kapoor) 写道，创业学校看起来就像“一个只崇拜金钱的人的巨型教堂”。

YC 合伙人泰勒·博斯梅尼 (Tyler Bosmeny) 拍手回应：“纽约市金融兄弟说什么？”

男人所做的就是撒谎、欺骗，然后去 yc 创业学校——米歇尔 (@michellewang857) 2026 年 7 月 25 日

对于其他人来说，创业学校的伟大之处在于对 YC 原则的放弃。

Spellbook 联合创始人斯科特·史蒂文森 (Scott Stevenson) 写道：“YC 品牌给人的感觉就像是为了过滤掉地位追逐者而设计的。” “你可以感觉到牛群冲进一个满溢的谷仓。 一个体育场大小的谷仓。”

YC 一直以来都非常挑剔，其录取率只有 1%。 尽管如此，YC 普通合伙人 Christopher Golda 仍为该活动的规模进行了辩护，他写道，加速器的目标从来都不是“稀缺性”。

戈尔达写道：“有更多的人能够、应该并且将会出现在竞技场上。” “所以，是的，我们租了一个竞技场。”
